critical_steps: The original (T,T)-controlled form is represented by the positive definite matrix TST.
The claimed (T^2,I)-controlled mixed form is nonreal at the explicit vector (1,i).
The source proof uses TSU=STU without assuming TS=ST.
Adding TS=ST validates the disputed operator interchange.
integrity.proof_basis: Exact one-point continuous g-fusion system on C^2 and direct 2x2 matrix calculations.
integrity.unproved_limits: No complete characterization of all control pairs for which the two mixed forms agree is asserted.

scientific_limitations: The finding corrects Theorem 3.8 only and does not reassess all later product or square-root claims in the preprint.
Commutation of the first control with the ordinary g-fusion frame operator is given as a sufficient repair, not a necessary condition in every special configuration.
An unindexed erratum, thesis remark, or informal correction may contain the same observation.
title: A noncommuting frame operator breaks a controlled g-fusion characterization
